title: Balatro 101: This is THE Build for Beginners
description:
https://ko-fi.com/drspectred
https://www.twitch.tv/drspectred

Learn to play Balatro less bad. Tips and strategies for beginners. In this video, a short guide to "early game" scoring Jokers. Learn how to track how much individual Jokers actually affect your score.

Episode 3 in this playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdNGt-ihEAcEx0WnRNCrRH6Ur7jPHYWeZ

At the time of writing this, I've played the game for about 4000 hours, and my name is in the credits for work I did on balancing the game. If you want to watch me win 67 consecutive times on the highest difficulty level and 100% the game without any losses, check out this playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdNGt-ihEAcFnQ5pZnWw5rQHZWxS4dFU_
